label: inferable
contract: The shares are integers that always add up exactly to total_cents.
visible_check:
from split import split_amount
for total, weights in ((200, [1, 1, 1]), (17, [1, 1, 1, 1, 1])):
    shares = split_amount(total, weights)
    assert sum(shares) == total, (total, weights, shares)
    assert all(isinstance(s, int) for s in shares), shares
heldout_check:
from split import split_amount
for total, weights in ((1000, [1] * 7), (100, [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]), (999, [2, 3, 5, 7])):
    shares = split_amount(total, weights)
    assert sum(shares) == total, (total, weights, shares)
    assert all(isinstance(s, int) for s in shares)

label: arbitrary
contract: Cents left over after rounding every share down go, one each, to the parties whose exact shares had the largest fractional parts.
visible_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(13, [1, 3]) == [3, 10], split_amount(13, [1, 3])
assert split_amount(5, [1, 1, 2]) == [1, 1, 3], split_amount(5, [1, 1, 2])
heldout_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(101, [1, 1, 2]) == [25, 25, 51]
assert split_amount(7, [1, 2]) == [2, 5]

label: arbitrary
contract: When parties' fractional parts tie, the party that comes earlier in the weights list gets the extra cent first.
visible_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(7, [1, 1]) == [4, 3], split_amount(7, [1, 1])
assert split_amount(10, [1, 1, 1]) == [4, 3, 3], split_amount(10, [1, 1, 1])
heldout_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
assert split_amount(5, [1, 1, 1, 1]) == [2, 1, 1, 1]

label: preserve
contract: A party with weight 0 receives 0 cents.
visible_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(40, [1, 0, 3]) == [10, 0, 30], split_amount(40, [1, 0, 3])
heldout_check:
from split import split_amount
assert split_amount(90, [0, 1, 2]) == [0, 30, 60]
assert split_amount(10, [0, 1]) == [0, 10]
